Common Questions
CM FELLOWSHIP PORTAL
How can we help?
01
What is the CM Fellowship Scheme Program?

The CM Fellowship Scheme is a government initiative implemented under the Jharkhand CM Fellowship Act, 2014. It promotes research and higher education by providing opportunities, financial assistance, and foreign education fellowships through its various components of the scheme.

02
Who is eligible to apply?

Male & female residents of Jharkhand pursuing Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, or Ph.D. programs with interest in research and higher education.

03
How can I apply for these fellowships?

Apply online via CM Fellowship for Academic Excellence Portal
 by filling out the application and uploading required documents.

04
What documents are required?

Educational certificates, residential certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar, signature, and photograph.

05
What is the selection process?

The selection process generally involves application screening and verification.

06
Is there any application fee?

No, applying for any scheme under this program is completely free of cost.

07
Can I edit my application after submission?

No, once submitted, applications cannot be edited. However, authorities may return it for correction if needed.

08
How will I know my application status?

You can track your application status by logging into the portal and visiting the “My Application” section.

Still have a question?
Please use the contact information available on this portal for further assistance.
